# Vyamit AI

Vyamit AI is Vyaapar's Mitra AI, also known as Vyapar Mitra AI: a voice-first shop management platform built by Vyamit Technology Systems Private Limited for Indian small businesses. It is designed for retail and wholesale shops that need fast billing, clear inventory control, customer ledger and udhaar management, GST-ready invoices, UPI-ready virtual bills, printer support, and business insights in one command center.

## Core product value

- Voice-first billing for counters and busy shop floors
- Inventory management and live stock awareness
- Customer ledger and amount due tracking
- Ledger, udhaar, lending and credit tracking for shopkeepers
- GST-ready invoices and professional billing output
- UPI-ready virtual bills and digital record sharing
- Cloud history, business insights, and a modern mobile experience

## Who it is for

Kirana and grocery stores, pharmacies, hardware and electrical shops, clothing and garment stores, retailers, wholesalers and distributors, dairy and bakery retailers, and other small businesses in India.

## Product approach

Shopkeepers can speak naturally in familiar languages and dialects. Vyamit AI is designed to recognise items and quantities, prepare bills, update connected records, and make business data easier to act on.
